description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Patrol Signaler, untapping the basic Plains.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Kithkin Soldier, untapping the Plains.
Repeat.
